content.text: Norm arch/alignment, no deformity, five toes
pes planus: PTTD; pes cavus: neurologic (CMT)
- Bogginess: boggy: synovitis/effusion                                       -    Effusion: intra-articular pathology/synovitis
- Swelling: swollen/boggy: synovitis, effusion, or injury         -    Ecchymosis: present: trauma/frx
- Muscular defects: palpable gap: muscle/tendon rupture
- Nodules: nodule: rheumatoid nodule/gouty tophus; cyst: ganglion
- Muscular defects: palpable gap: Achilles rupture
- Tenderness/Spurs (calcaneus): lateral: ATFL sprain; medial: deltoid
- Tender/Spurs (calcaneus): frx; plantar spur: plantar fasciitis/heel spur
- Swelling: podagra: gout      - Warmth: 1st MTP warm: gout (podagra)
Foot drop → common peroneal n. or L5; screen with heel/toe walking
weak dorsiflex: foot drop (peroneal n./L4–L5); weak plantarflex: S1/Achilles
weak extend (EHL): L5 (sensitive for L5 radiculopathy)
Evals: partial or complete rupture of A. talofibular ligament of ankle
:  pt supine, knee at 20’, heel resting on palm of examiner’s hand, stabilize calcaneus, other hand pushes tibia & fibula P.
evals: partial or complete rupture of the A. talofibular ligament & the calcaneofibular ligament
: sit w foot & ankle unsupported, foot in 10-20’ of plantarflex, stabilized lower leg &  hindfoot =everted/inverted
Adds CFL to what drawer tests.
lies prone, squeeze relaxed calf musc -> contractAchilles tendon ->  plantar flex.
Highly specific; palpable gap may be felt.
